habitat: Forests, wooded hillsides and open woodland with scattered trees, forest edges and riparian corridors; sea level to 3600 m
description: Medium-large grey-brown cuckoo, paler grey throat and upper breast, white underparts with broad dark barring and a long tail edged with prominent white spots; brood parasite (hosts mostly drongos and crows); loud four-note call rendered "one more bottle".
